_moduleContext.name: Temperature Converter
_moduleContext.author: MAM Team
_moduleContext.description: Convert between Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin temperature scales
_moduleContext.purpose: Convert between Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin temperature scales

outputs.name: formula
outputs.description: The formula used for the conversion

rules: Support only Celsius ("C"), Fahrenheit ("F"), and Kelvin ("K")
Invalid units must return an error message
Results must be rounded to 2 decimal places
Same-unit conversions must return the input value unchanged
Absolute zero (-273.15 C, -459.67 F, 0 K) must be enforced as minimum
